topic.title: A task, its conversation and its actions
topic.shortdesc: A task page shows what came in, every agent run with its full transcript and cost, and the actions it proposed.

image.alt: A task page: the email that came in and the agent's conversation on the left, its proposed actions on the right.

dlentry.dd: The business, status and what came in. An email shows its sender, date and attachments; automated mail is folded away (Show it). Below: the role, kind of work, route, urgency and age.
A failed task can be retried. A deferred one can be run now, ignoring the daily budget for this one run.
Each agent run, with its cost and transcript. Tool calls are folded as → tool and their results as ← result; open one to see exactly what the agent sent and got back.
The same request for the same business within a few minutes is linked to the first task instead of running again. Open the original task goes there.

body.p: On a phone, Conversation and Actions tabs switch between the two halves; the Actions badge counts what waits for you.

When a task is done, failed or waiting for approval, the box under the conversation sends the agent a reply: answer its question, change the plan, or ask for something else. The task runs again with your reply and its earlier work. Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line; the microphone dictates.
The actions this task proposed, pending ones first. They work exactly as in Approvals.
